name: Powdered Sugar (Confectioners)
siboNotes: Pure sucrose is well-absorbed in the small intestine and typically well-tolerated in SIBO. Small amounts used in baking are generally fine.
preparationTips: Sift before using to remove lumps and ensure even distribution
Store in airtight container to prevent clumping from moisture
Perfect for dusting baked goods or making quick glazes
Contains small amount of cornstarch which is FODMAP-friendly
nutritionalHighlights: Pure carbohydrate source providing quick energy
Contains trace amounts of cornstarch as anti-caking agent
Very low in vitamins and minerals
